author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: Three-bit macro Pauli/Walsh crossing constructions with exact integer factors and weighted support ranks. A local dual closes the three-class family. A frozen 27-term four-macro dual and a tensorization/averaging lemma force some same piece in every six-class macro-type-constant decomposition to have both word supports at least 129654^floor(R/4), ruling out the target crossing rate in this family. This is not a SAT improvement or a lower bound for arbitrary crossing pieces.

A construction changing local class invariance, global macro permutation symmetry or Pauli-diagonal representation; unchanged coarse/six-class screens are closed
Complete master recursion and arbitrary-density costs for any improved successor
